data.title: Michael Burry Sounds the Alarm Again: AI Is a Circular Financing Web With Nvidia In the Middle
data.description: Michael Burry is pointing at a $770 billion AI spending wave and asking whether the money circling through hyperscalers, chip makers, and AI labs is creating real value or just the appearance of it.
data.keywords: Nvidia, Michael Burry, credit markets, free cash flow, customer demand
